title: studio-profile.v1
description: One artefact type of the creative studio, as data: its seats, what each seat loads, what is captured, who judges, and the caps. scripts/studio.py reads THIS file for the shape (through the validator of scripts/studio_verdict.py, so only the keywords that validator implements are used here) and adds the rules a schema cannot say; each is named in the description of the field it guards.

artefact.description: The piece in words, with its article, as it reads in a brief: `a website page`.

work_kind.description: rendered: variants are captured in a browser and judged from tiles. text: variants are judged as text; there is no capture (capture_kind).

private.description: true: the run directory is created with mode 0700.

max_agents.description: The most agents the PLAN of a run may hold: its planned spawns and the spawns of its permitted retries. A compiled plan over it is refused (plan_over_cap). Repair rounds are not in this number: `plan` prints them on top of it, at most two agent turns each, and the last number of that line (cap with repairs) is the ceiling of the run. `--budget N` holds the whole ceiling inside N.

borrow_max.description: The most borrow cards a critic may write.

brief.description: The fields of the run's brief (a JSON object; each value a string or a list of strings).

constraints.description: The constraints round: ONE agent that loads the named skills and writes constraints.md, which every maker receives. It runs in light mode too.

tier.description: The execution tier the main loop spawns the seat at.

loads.description: What a seat loads: `family:<name>` (every skill that declares that family; an empty family is refused) or a skill name. Each one must resolve against the skills root before the run directory exists.

asks.description: What constraints.md must hold, one item per line of the list.

functions.description: The functions rivalry happens within. Each has exactly two rival seats (rivals_not_two) whose family tokens share nothing (rivals_share_family). The FIRST function makes the piece: its seats are the variants. A further function names the first in `attached_to` (piece_function_first, attached_to_unknown): each of its seats is paired at random with one variant and writes its part into that variant's directory before the piece is built.

axis_set.description: The named axis set of scripts/studio_axes.py that the direction contracts fill (axis_set_unknown).

output.description: The file a maker writes in its variant directory. A seat of an attached function writes this file and `<function id>-contract.md` there.

attached_to.description: The id of the first function. This function's seats write a part (for example the words of a page) that the paired seat of the first function builds on.

baseline.description: When present: the first `first_runs` runs of this profile under a run root add a single-maker variant, the user ranks the variants blind before the verdict is shown, and the comparison is recorded as provisional.

capture.description: true: every variant is captured by scripts/studio_capture.py before the critic reads.

text_check.description: Text work only, and required for it (text_check_kind): what scripts/studio_claims.py checks in every draft before the critic reads. truth_pack: the brief carries a truth pack (its `truth-pack` field must be required: truth_pack_field) and every listed sentence is matched to it. outline: the heading outline of constraints.md is checked. length: the brief's `length` band is checked (length_field). first_screen: the critic fills a `first-screen` entry per variant, and a winner whose entry does not hold is refused. An unlabelled placeholder is always checked.

critic.description: Who judges: exactly one of `skill` (with the `references` of that skill to inline in the critic brief) or `reference` (one file, relative to the skills root) (critic_one_of, critic_references). The convergence rule file is inlined beside them.

loads.description: Skills the critic loads by name before reading (each must resolve).

finish.description: The passes on the winner, in order. Their findings are merged; nothing is picked between them.

tier.description: The execution tier the main loop spawns the seat at.

loads.description: What a seat loads: `family:<name>` (every skill that declares that family; an empty family is refused) or a skill name. Each one must resolve against the skills root before the run directory exists.

asks.description: The goal line of the pass's brief.

retries.description: The retries a plan permits, each 0 or 1: one redo when the rival contracts are equal on every axis, one re-make round after no_award.

light.description: What light mode leaves out. The constraints round, the makers of the piece, one critic read and the baseline are never dropped. claim_seat: no claim-check seat. attached_seats: no seat of an attached function; the makers of the piece write that part themselves.

claim_check.description: The one light seat that rules on the statements the runner could not match by their literal figures, dates and names. Only with evidence.text_check.truth_pack (claim_seat_needs_truth_pack). Light mode may drop it (`claim_seat`): unmatched statements then stay unsupported and are listed for the user.

tier.description: The execution tier the main loop spawns the seat at.

seat.description: A maker seat. Its brief carries, whole, the entry file of every skill it loads, each one's `doctrine` file when named, and the school and format files when named (copy seats). No path may leave the skills root (path_leaves_root). Seat ids are unique in a profile and are not constraints, baseline, critic, winner or claim-check (seat_id_taken). Two seats that load the same skill differ by `angle` (angle_unknown, angles_equal).

tier.description: The execution tier the main loop spawns the seat at.

loads.description: What a seat loads: `family:<name>` (every skill that declares that family; an empty family is refused) or a skill name. Each one must resolve against the skills root before the run directory exists.

doctrine.description: A file inside EVERY skill the seat loads, relative to that skill: the doctrine with the house's axis table.

school_file.description: Copy seats: the school file, relative to the skills root.

format_file.description: Copy seats: the format file, relative to the skills root.

angle.description: For rivals that share a skill: this seat's value on the `angle` axis of the function's axis set. The seat's direction contract must hold it.

angle_brief.description: One or two sentences that say what the angle means for the piece; they go in the seat's brief.
